contentHtml:
dairy free cake mix is your ticket to cloud-light cake that melts on the tongue. Silky coconut milk stands in for cream, while aquafaba whips into glossy peaks for lift and nostalgia without dairy. A velvety vanilla bean batter gets a kiss of maple syrup and a swirl of bright berry compote so every slice feels like a celebration. Trade butter for pillowy cashew cream frosting and swap spirits for zesty lemon extract, and you have a playful, irresistible dessert that is as joyful to bake as it is to devour. One bite and dairy free cake mix tastes like pure magic.

Why You’ll Love This dairy free cake mix

  • Indulge in a cake that’s rich in flavor without the dairy guilt.
  • Enjoy a moist, fluffy texture that rivals traditional cake mixes.
  • Perfect for those with dietary restrictions or lactose intolerance.
  • Easy to prepare, making baking a breeze for everyone.
  • Versatile for any occasion—birthdays, holidays, or just because!

dairy free cake mix

Discover the revolutionary dairy free cake mix that delivers jaw-dropping taste! Indulge guilt-free and elevate your baking game! 🎂✨
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 10 minutes mins
Cook Time 30 minutes mins
cooling 10 minutes mins
Total Time 50 minutes mins
Servings: 8 servings
Course: Dessert
Cuisine: Vegan
Calories: 250
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dry Ingredients
  • 2 cups all-purpose flour the base of your cake
  • 1.5 cups granulated sugar for sweetness
  • 0.5 cup unsweetened cocoa powder for rich chocolate flavor
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder helps the cake rise
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda for leavening
  • 0.5 teaspoon salt enhances the flavors
Wet Ingredients
  • 1 cup unsweetened plant-based milk such as almond or soy
  • 0.33 cup vegetable oil for moisture
  • 2 teaspoons vanilla extract adds depth of flavor
  • 1 cup water to make it the perfect batter

Equipment

  • 1 8-inch cake pan Greased and floured for easy removal
  • 1 Large mixing bowl For mixing dry and wet ingredients
  • 1 whisk For combining dry ingredients
  • 1 Spatula For mixing and pouring batter

Method
 

Preparation Steps
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This ensures your cake bakes evenly and perfectly.
  2. Grease and flour an 8-inch cake pan. This will help your cake come out easily after baking.
  3. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Make sure everything is well combined.
  4. Add the plant-based milk, oil, vanilla extract, and water to the dry ingredients. Stir until smooth and no lumps remain.
  5. Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Make sure it’s evenly spread out.
  6. Bake for 25–30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Keep an eye on it!
  7. Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then, transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

How to Make dairy free cake mix

Get ready to bake a delightful dairy free cake! This recipe takes about 10 minutes to prepare, 25–30 minutes to cook, and a little cooling time before you can dig in. Let’s get started!

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). This ensures your cake bakes evenly and perfectly.

Step 2: Prepare the Cake Pan

Grease and flour an 8-inch cake pan. This will help your cake come out easily after baking.

Step 3: Mix the Dry Ingredients

In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Make sure everything is well combined.

Step 4: Add the Wet Ingredients

Add the plant-based milk, oil, vanilla extract, and water to the dry ingredients. Stir until smooth and no lumps remain.

Step 5: Pour the Batter

Pour the batter into the prepared pan. Make sure it’s evenly spread out.

Step 6: Bake the Cake

Bake for 25–30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Keep an eye on it!

Step 7: Cool the Cake

Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then, transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely before serving.

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making dairy free cake mix

  • Opt for unsweetened applesauce to replace eggs for moisture.
  • Incorporate a splash of vanilla extract for enhanced flavor.
  • Use coconut milk for a rich, creamy texture.
  • Mix in dairy-free chocolate chips for a delightful surprise.
  • Let the cake cool completely before frosting for best results.

How to Serve this dairy free cake mix

  • Top with a luscious dairy-free chocolate ganache for a rich finish.
  • Serve with a scoop of coconut milk ice cream for a delightful contrast.
  • Pair with fresh berries and a drizzle of maple syrup for a fruity twist.
  • Dust with powdered sugar and add a side of dairy-free whipped cream for extra indulgence.
  • Enjoy as a layered cake with dairy-free frosting between the layers for a showstopper dessert.
  • Slice and serve with a warm cup of herbal tea for a cozy afternoon treat.

Make Ahead and Storage

You can make this cake ahead and store it easily:

Storing dairy free cake mix Leftovers

  • Allow the cake to cool completely.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap.
  • Store in an airtight container.
  • Keep in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.

Freezing dairy free cake mix

  • Wrap the cooled cake in plastic wrap.
  • Place it in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Label with the date and type of cake.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.

Reheating dairy free cake mix

  • Thaw the cake in the refrigerator overnight.
  • Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Wrap the cake in foil to retain moisture.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes until warm.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. Which box cake mix is dairy free?

Many brands offer dairy-free cake mixes, including some varieties from brands like Duncan Hines and Betty Crocker. Always check the ingredient list to ensure there are no dairy products included, as formulations can change. You can also find specialty brands that focus on allergen-free baking, which often have delicious options!

2. Are Betty Crocker cake mixes dairy free?

Some Betty Crocker cake mixes are dairy-free, but not all. It’s essential to read the labels carefully, as certain flavors may contain milk or milk derivatives. Look for their gluten-free or specific dairy-free labeled mixes for the best options!

3. Is Aldi cake mix dairy free?

Aldi offers a variety of cake mixes, and some of them are dairy-free. However, similar to other brands, it’s crucial to check the packaging for any dairy ingredients. Aldi’s private label products often have clear labeling, making it easier to find suitable options!

4. Is Pillsbury White Cake Mix dairy free?

Pillsbury White Cake Mix is not typically dairy-free, as it often contains milk products. However, they do have some options that are dairy-free, so be sure to check the ingredient list or look for their specific allergen-free products to find a suitable mix!

Final Thoughts

Get ready to indulge in a slice of nostalgia with our revolutionary dairy free cake mix! It’s simple, rewarding, and bursting with flavor that will have everyone asking for seconds.
